Clinical Conditions, Disorders and their Nutritional Management

blocks.text: Inflammatory Gastroduodenal Disorders (Peptic ulcer diseases, Gastritis, gastroenteritis)

Peptic Ulcers: These are ulcers of the stomach or duodenum or both. Commonly caused by infection e.g. H Pylori and mucosal injuries (acid, NSAID, iatrogenic) they increased risk of bleeding and perforation. Gastritis: inflammation of the lining of the stomach. It can develop suddenly (acute gastritis) or gradually over time (chronic gastritis).

blocks.text: Gastroenteritis: Is the inflammation of the stomach and small intestines, often caused by viral, fungal, or bacterial infections, leading to diarrhea, vomiting, and abdominal pain.
